description: Use this before touching a native project, once a kit has been chosen. One Native Kit's full manifest, so nobody has to reverse-engineer the application it came from: every file in its packaged source with its content hash and the production path it was cut from, every pinned dependency and why that pin, every permission, entitlement, background mode and plist or manifest key with what breaks when it is absent, the JavaScript interface, the configuration that must not be changed and the reason for each, the ordered install steps including the ones that need a human in Xcode or a provider console, what is proven and how, and the real constraints. The packaged source itself is not distributed yet, and no kit carries a price. Read this before touching a native project.
name: trustycap_get_native_kit
title: Get a TrustyCap Native Kit
